$comment: Tracked pinned closure for the Crosscheck reviewer model image.
These are the values that were previously supplied only in an operator-local
parameters file and recorded nowhere, which made a built image impossible to
reproduce: the image tags preserve each digest but not the URL or byte count
the build also requires. Compose the full --parameters file for
bin/fm-crosscheck-azure-image.sh by adding the installation-specific values
modelGuest pair derived from the tracked guest, as docs/azure-crosscheck.md
describes. Every digest here was computed by downloading the artifact, not
piTarball must stay equal to PI_URL/PI_BYTES/PI_DIGEST in
bin/fm-azure-cell-image.sh so a Pi reviewer and a Pi author run one agent;
tests/fm-crosscheck-azure.test.sh enforces that rather than asking for it.
